name: Turkish wine
blurb: The Turkish wine industry as a business: vineyards, wineries, the rules, how wine reaches drinkers, and the restaurants and hotels wineries run. Follows the order wine business is formally taught, with Turkey as the example throughout.
framework: WSET Diploma order (production, then business, then market), adapted to Turkey and weighted towards business.

syllabus.title: A huge vineyard, a small wine industry
syllabus.goal: Explain the basic shape of Turkish wine in two minutes

syllabus.title: Ancient Anatolia to the Ottomans
syllabus.goal: Trace wine from the Hittites through Byzantium to the minority winemakers of the empire

syllabus.title: The Republic, Atatürk and the state monopoly
syllabus.goal: Explain how the state shaped wine from 1923 and who the first private houses were

syllabus.title: 1990 to today: the quality turn and the boutiques
syllabus.goal: Say why the modern industry is only about 30 years old, and what changed in 2013

syllabus.title: The map: regions and what each is known for
syllabus.goal: Place any Turkish wine you meet in its region

syllabus.title: A year in the vineyard
syllabus.goal: Follow a grower's calendar and its main risks

syllabus.title: Native red grapes
syllabus.goal: Recognise Öküzgözü, Boğazkere and Kalecik Karası by style

syllabus.title: Native whites and rediscovered grapes
syllabus.goal: Recognise Narince and Emir, and explain the revival movement

syllabus.title: From grape to bottle
syllabus.goal: Describe how red, white, rosé and sparkling wines are made

syllabus.title: Judging quality without appellations
syllabus.goal: Read a Turkish label and know what it does not tell you

syllabus.title: Vineyard economics
syllabus.goal: Estimate what land, planting and yields mean for cost

syllabus.title: Winery economics
syllabus.goal: Tell a grape-buying winery from an estate, and why it matters

syllabus.title: Who's who: large houses and boutiques
syllabus.goal: Name the main producers and how they differ

syllabus.title: Operating under the rules
syllabus.goal: Explain how licensing, tax and the promotion ban shape daily decisions

syllabus.title: How wine is sold in Turkey
syllabus.goal: Trace a bottle from winery to shop, restaurant and hotel

syllabus.title: Marketing without advertising
syllabus.goal: Describe what producers do instead, and what is risky

syllabus.title: Wine tourism and the vineyard routes
syllabus.goal: Compare the routes and what a visitor business needs

syllabus.title: Winery restaurants, hotels and wine bars
syllabus.goal: Explain why hospitality is part of the business model

syllabus.title: Exports
syllabus.goal: Say where Turkish wine sells abroad and what holds it back

syllabus.title: Lessons from Greece and Georgia
syllabus.goal: Compare Turkey with two neighbours that built export identities

syllabus.title: Climate, old vines and vineyard loss
syllabus.goal: Explain the long decline in vineyard area and who is resisting it

syllabus.title: Business models that work
syllabus.goal: Weigh the main ways to build a wine business in Turkey
